The iOS 27 beta 5 rolled out this week, confirming a feature Apple has been hinting at: upgrading to a higher-tier iCloud+ paid plan to unlock more Apple Intelligence features.

Upgrading your iCloud+ plan unlocks more iOS 27 AI features

If you subscribe to iCloud+ or Apple One, upgrading to iOS 27 will bring new features.

You'll get more access to capped Apple Intelligence features (like image generation), as well as new HomeKit secure video features for your cameras.

However, according to the iOS 27 beta 5, it appears that the caps for these new features are tied to which iCloud+ plan tier you subscribe to.

In the Home app → Home settings → Apple Intelligence → Cameras & Languages section, iOS 27 now displays how many cameras your iCloud+ plan supports for AI summaries. Quoting Stephen Robles on X:

The right-hand image Robles shared shows that after tapping "View iCloud+ Plan" on the Cameras & Languages page, a new screen pops up with the following text:

Upgrade your iCloud+ plan for more Apple Intelligence features. Get more smart features, more storage, and more.

The page shows your current plan and offers an option to upgrade to a higher tier. It doesn't yet list all the different plans — likely a small beta issue that will be corrected before launch.

From what I've seen in the beta so far, the 2TB iCloud+ plan appears to offer AI summaries for 5 cameras, while the 12TB plan supports up to 15. Details for other plans aren't clear yet.

But based on the wording of this new upgrade page in the beta, it's almost certain that each higher-tier iCloud+ plan won't just bump up the number of cameras that get AI summaries — it'll also raise the usage caps on other AI features.

This lines up with what CEO Tim Cook said on Apple's last earnings call.

What do you think about Apple tying AI feature caps to iCloud+ plan tiers? Let us know in the comments.
